betaInvite.previewText: Transform your selfies into professional headshots with AI - Welcome to Primeshot!
betaInvite.heading: Welcome to Primeshot beta!
betaInvite.paragraph1: We're opening the doors to the Primeshot Closed Beta, and you're invited in. We welcome your feedback to guide what we build next.
betaInvite.paragraph2: You are one of the very first to experience a completely new way of getting professional headshots. No studios. No scheduling. Just instant results, straight from your selfies.
betaInvite.offerText: To say thanks, here is your early access offer:
betaInvite.offerDescription: Help shape Primeshot, get lifetime 70% off annual or 50% off monthly, and claim exclusive perks for the Founding 300.
